blocks.text: For each building named below, the nearest transit, parks, schools and shopping come from TransLink or BC Transit, the municipality, the Ministry of Education and Child Care and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on November 2, 2026 on OpenStreetMap routing, starting at the building’s street address (or the nearest point on its street where the map has no point for the building itself, marked in the table). Facts that neighbouring buildings share are listed once, under the first of them. School catchments are not confirmed for these addresses: confirm with the school district before relying on one.

items.t: Transit: No rapid-transit station in Chilliwack. Nearest by bus: Lougheed Town Centre Stn, Route 66 terminus, reached from Vedder Rd at Luckakuck Way. Route 51 Vedder: UFV Chilliwack Campus to Downtown Chilliwack via Vedder Rd at Luckakuck Way. Route 52 Evans: Cottonwood Mall to Downtown Chilliwack via Evans Rd at Yale Rd and Hodgins Ave at Ashwell Rd.
Parks and recreation: Webster Park: City park with skateboard park, playground and spray zone at 44524 Keith Wilson Road. Sardis Sports Complex, 5725 Tyson Road.
Schools: Evans Elementary, K-5, SD33, 7600 Evans Rd. Sardis Secondary, 9-12, SD33, 45460 Stevenson Rd. Vedder Middle School, 6-8, SD33, 45560 South Sumas Rd.
Shopping: Cottonwood Centre (shopping centre), 45585 Luckakuck Way. Save-On-Foods (grocery), 6014 Vedder Rd.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
